on Monday announced the appointment of Jean-Raymond Boulle II as Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1, 2026.
Boulle will succeed Lester Kemp, who has served as the company's interim CEO since November 2025.
Following the transition, Kemp will remain actively involved with Star Diamond in an advisory role.

Boulle has held founder, director, and CEO-level positions in several companies related to the MedTech and Biotech sectors. In the diamond industry, he is a Founding Director of a diamond mining & exploration company with operations in Angola and Namibia.

title: Star Diamond appoints Jean Raymond Boulle II as CEO
